0022600032.text: The Trail Blazers (5-1, 1st in the Northwest, 3rd in the West, on a two-game winning streak and 4-0 on the road) visit the Los Angeles Lakers (6-2, 1st in the Pacific, 4th in the West, also on a two-game winning streak) in an Emirates NBA Cup West Group C game. Portland is missing Ja Morant (hamstring) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery), while Los Angeles is without Adou Thiero (knee inflammation). Portland leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after its 136-129 win in Los Angeles on October 27, and the Trail Blazers won the 2025-26 series 2-1.
